sources.title: Crímenes de odio en Argentina: aumento y récord de uno cada 38 horas - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: Agencia Presentes (19 March 2026) on the Observatorio Nacional de Crimenes de Odio report: at least 227 hate crimes motivated by sexual orientation or gender identity in 2025, up 62 percent year-on-year and the Observatory's highest count in ten years of operation - one every 38 hours. Most perpetrators were security-force personnel or unidentified attackers in public space; beatings were the dominant method; activists link the surge to the national government's 'cultural battle' rhetoric against the LGBTIQ+ collective, and attacks continued into early 2026.
